# Native captured-frame stream

`CaptureFrames` borrows an actual native parameter/free variable in its owning source function. The root observation precedes native capture constructions; subsequent observations are exact free variables authenticated by existing `ClosureBindings`, in depth-first construction order. Construction is not invocation. Callback parameters, replacement cells and unrelated values grant no selected-value authority. The implementation retains active native ancestry, never a capture, instruction or function population; arbitrary depth is not claimed constant-memory.

The complete12-mode native source domain crosses uninvoked/immediate/callback construction, one/two capture edges and selected/unrelated values. Every mode also exercises a non-vacuous foreign-owner mutation. A separate native free-variable root verifies transitive source custody. The21-case rejection matrix covers missing/typed-nil/foreign/copied roots, values, targets, layouts, locals and a contradictory block ordinal, while checking the exact root prefix and one zero refusal. Hostile-tail, native cancellation-cause and direct callback-stop cases challenge delivery authority. First-loan widths32/8193 exclude compiler construction and reject materialized instruction populations.

Seven native one-fact controls must fail behavioral assertions: omitted root, dropped transitive captures, discarded capture refusal, wrong selected value, ignored stop, lost initial cancellation cause and a copied instruction population. The new stream composes existing authority; it does not duplicate capture matching, native ordering or invocation interpretation. Existing closure-binding evidence is retained separately with unchanged-source hashes and explicit helper-source differences.

Retain source identities, exact commands, native output, refusals and mutation results. Run focused race proof and tools; then serial three-second benchmarks and semantic fuzzing. Fuzz inputs reach the producer and challenge both selected-value semantics and changed native ownership. No local result issues independent acceptance.
